description: Patch a step's wait or channel. True PATCH. `step_index` itself is not patchable — reordering re-aims a lead's cursor at copy it never saw. Requires draft or paused; an active campaign returns 409 naming the fix (pause it).

wait_days.description: Days to wait BEFORE this step (0-365).

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: send_update_step
